messages:
Maya: quick poll — working late tonight. best late-night takeout near the office? drop your pick (1 vote each)

Options: 1) Noodle Place (ramen/bao) 2) Taco Corner (al pastor) 3) 24/7 Diner (burgers/fries) 4) Sushi Express (rolls + bento)

Jon: 1) Noodle Place for me :ramen: hungry now

Sam: 2) Taco Corner :taco: also cheapest delivery fee iirc

Lina: 4) Sushi Express — light and easy to eat while coding, pls no wasabi mishaps :sweat_smile:

Alex: 3) 24/7 Diner — late-night vibe + coffee, I can swing by pickup if ppl want :ok_hand:

Maya: neat — tally so far: Noodle 1, Taco 1, Sushi 1, Diner 1. tie city :joy: any constraints? allergies?

Sam: gluten-free taco option at Taco Corner is solid. also they do group order discounts sometimes

Jon: Noodle Place has that new spicy miso bowl — obsessed. willing to chip for delivery if folks order in 15m

Lina: can anyone handle sushi pickup? i'm allergic to sesame so would need them to skip the seeds

Alex: i can pick up sushi on the way back at 8:15pm if we go with Sushi Express. who wants me to include soy/wasabi packets?

Maya: ok rules: 1) each person 1 vote 2) if tie, order with most pickup volunteers 3) final call at 7:50pm. sounds good?

Sam: sounds good to me.

Jon: yep, 7:50 final.

Lina: vote confirmed for 4) Sushi Express — and yes pls no sesame

Alex: noted. I'll post ETA + total in channel when I head out.

order-bot: POLL CLOSED — results: Noodle Place:1, Taco Corner:1, 24/7 Diner:1, Sushi Express:2. Winner: Sushi Express (by volunteer pickup) :party:

Maya: awesome — thanks all! Alex you're a hero :raised_hands:
